title: The Eve of the Storm
next_chapter_hook: As Chen Ling's figure turned for one last glance at the Imperial Capital city gate, the entire chessboard of the Tianji Pavilion seemed to tremble—and high above in the clouds, that Heavenly Eye gazing upon the mortal realm finally opened its gaze.

text.content: In the grand hall, the gold-bricked imperial pathway shimmered with cold light in the morning sun. The Crown Prince's deep eyes locked死死 onto Chen Ji, as all ministers in the hall held their breath, as if they could hear a needle fall. Chen Ji slowly raised his head, a faint, serene smile playing at his lips—three parts composure, seven parts insight— as if the Crown Prince's questioning was merely idle chatter over tea.

dialogue.content: "I report to Your Highness the Crown Prince that I am merely a commoner, graciously granted the position of Grand Preceptor by imperial decree." Chen Ji's voice remained steady as water, each word precisely measured. "As for which divine being... if Your Highness wishes to know, perhaps you should personally ask that old sect leader of the Tianqing Sect."

text.content: At these words, the hall erupted in uproar. Ling Yuan—that reclusive old sect leader—was somehow connected to this waste of a servant disciple? The Crown Prince's gaze darkened instantly, his fists secretly clenching within his sleeves. Yet Chen Ji appeared utterly oblivious, turning leisurely as his gaze swept past the ranks of ministers to fall upon the gray sky beyond the hall. There, an almost invisible fissure was slowly writhing.

dialogue.content: (The runes on the Tianji Record Fragment were burning faintly hot—this was... the third time. Chen Tianming, your call grows increasingly urgent. Are you eager to see me, or warning me of something?)

text.content: Meanwhile, outside the East Gate of the Imperial Capital. Autumn winds swirled countless yellow leaves across the sky as a procession slowly entered. At the head was a cold-faced woman carrying a sleeping youth in her arms—the youth's forehead mark identical to Chen Ji's. Behind her, a mysterious figure cloaked in black纱 maintained a distance of exactly three paces, shadows following like a specter.

dialogue.content: "Sister, we've arrived." Chen Ling whispered softly, her fingertips gently stroking the youth's—Chen Tianming's—forehead. "He keeps calling your name in his dreams... Is that person really there?"

text.content: From beneath the black纱, a hoarse laugh rang out: "Little girl, did you think you alone could find him?" The voice carried a hint of mockery. "The master of the Tianji Record... is not so easily met. But don't worry, soon he will come seeking us of his own accord." Chen Ling spun around sharply, only to see the black-robed figure toss an ancient token into the air—a token bearing a conspicuous "机" character.

dialogue.content: (This aura... it's Chen Ling? No, there's something else. Master Mo said the Heavenly Fate Key could interfere with the Tianji Record's foresight. It seems she's arrived at the Imperial Capital.) Chen Ji withdrew his gaze from the horizon, his expression unchanged. "If Your Highness the Crown Prince has no further questions, this commoner requests permission to withdraw."

text.content: The Crown Prince冷笑一笑, about to speak, when commotion suddenly erupted outside the hall. A guard commander rushed in, kneeling on one knee: "Your Majesty, Your Highness, unidentified cultivators have been detected in the eastern city—suspected of being from the Demonic Path!" The news struck like thunder in the court. Yet in the depths of Chen Ji's eyes, a flash of keen light appeared—Ye Qing's "Demonic Path Mists" had finally shown its weakness.

However, just as the court descended into chaos, aberration struck. The sky outside the hall suddenly darkened, and a pitch-black vortex silently unfolded beneath the noontime sun. Deep within the vortex, a colossal eye slowly opened—its pupil devoid of any emotion, containing only the coldest, most extreme scrutiny.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji." The voice did not come from within the vortex but rang directly in every mind present. "Host of the Tianji Record, rebel against fate. In Heaven's name, I hereby issue a Lethal Edict—whosoever takes his life may enter the Heavenly Sequence and obtain the opportunity for eternal life."

text.content: The entire Imperial Capital seemed crushed by invisible force, ministers prostrating one after another, even the Crown Prince's face turning deathly pale. This was the Heavenly Eye's Lethal Edict—legend had it that once targeted by such an existence, fleeing to the ends of the earth would not escape death. Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, gazing up at that eye spanning the heavens, yet the corner of his mouth curved in a mocking arc.

dialogue.content: "Lethal Edict?" Chen Ji laughed softly, his voice light yet clearly audible to everyone present. "I thought Heaven was more sophisticated. So this is all you've got? How many people want me dead—you're just one more."

text.content: These words sent shockwaves through the entire court. The Heavenly Eye seemed momentarily stunned, then emitted a low chuckle: "Interesting." The vortex slowly contracted, yet that cold pressure pressed upon Chen Ji's shoulders like a physical force. Master Mo's voice sounded in Chen Ji's mind, carrying unprecedented gravity: "Little one, you've landed in big trouble. But... this was anticipated."

dialogue.content: (Anticipated? Master Mo, how many things are you still hiding from me?) Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, his thoughts churning. Master Mo's voice continued: "Don't rush. Now is not the time for questions. Your... interesting sister has arrived at the Imperial Capital, and with her is someone even I cannot see through. Be careful—that person is no simple matter."

text.content: The court turmoil gradually subsided, ministers being taken away by guards under charges of "spreading heresy." The Crown Prince stormed off with a dark expression. In the vast golden hall, only Chen Ji stood alone. He looked down at the Tianji Record Fragment in his palm, its runes flickering madly—a sign of imminent major upheaval.

Chen Ling, the Demonic Saintess, the Crown Prince, the old sect leader, the Heavenly Eye... all the pieces were converging on the Imperial Capital. Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, allowing the power of the Tianji Record to spread through his Mental Sea. His foresight awakened once more—within the next three hours, at least three forces would strike at him simultaneously. And he must, before these lethal traps descend, lay out his own chess game.

choice.prompt: Faced with multiple lethal forces converging, what strategy will Chen Ji adopt to respond?

choices.description: Strike first, launch preemptive attacks before the enemy acts, transforming passivity into aggression. Use Chen Ling as bait to draw out the masterminds behind the scenes, eliminating them all in one fell swoop.
choices.visible_cost: May expose more trump cards, potentially drawing greater attention from the Heavenly Eye
choices.visible_reward: Clear all unstable factors within the Imperial Capital, seize the initiative
choices.risk_hint: If the plan is leaked, will offend multiple forces simultaneously

text.content: Chen Ji冷笑一声, since even Heaven sought his life, there was nothing left to hide. He waved his hand, and several transmission talismans pierced through the air—one for Ye Qing, one for Su Qingyao, even one sent to the Xuanwu Sect. Meanwhile, he slowly walked toward the hall's exterior, facing that still-undissipated Heavenly Eye. "You want to kill me? Come then."

The Heavenly Eye's pupil slightly contracted, then emitted an意味深长的低笑: "Interesting... are you challenging this one?" Chen Ji gave no answer, merely raising the Tianji Record Fragment high. Its runes blazed with dazzling light before the watching crowds— he was declaring to the entire world: the inheritor of the Tianji Record stands here before you.

choices.description: Hold position, observe quietly. Utilize the Tianji Record's foresight to precisely control the timing of each wave of attacks, striking precisely when enemies reveal weaknesses.
choices.visible_cost: May endure multiple rounds of attacks, Heavenly Fate value continuously depleting
choices.visible_reward: Preserve strength to the maximum, letting enemies wear each other down in the open
choices.risk_hint: If foresight proves inaccurate, will fall into a passive, defensive position

text.content: Chen Ji turned and departed, locking himself in a borrowed side hall. The Tianji Record Fragment floated before him, its runes moving like living things. What he sought to see were all possible lethal traps within the next three hours—then find that perfect evasion route.

Foresight images came in rapid succession: Chen Ling captured by mysterious figures, Ye Qing ambushed, the Crown Prince's assassins deploying in full force... Chen Ji recorded each one, the corner of his mouth curving coldly: "Want to kill me? Fine, but first ask if your blade is fast enough."

However, whether striking first or biding his time, Chen Ji knew one thing: the center of this storm could only be him. He slowly opened his eyes, his gaze piercing through countless palace walls to fall upon a certain direction in the eastern city—where Chen Ling held Chen Tianming, standing茫然 in the bustling crowd.

dialogue.content: "Sister, where do we go from here?" Chen Ling's voice carried a hint of anxiety. Chen Tianming stirred slightly in her arms, and beneath those closed eyelids, something seemed to be turning. Behind her, that black-robed figure lingered like a ghost, eyes perpetually fixed on a certain direction deep within the imperial city—precisely where Chen Ji resided.

text.content: Meanwhile, in a secret mansion somewhere in the Imperial Capital. Ye Qing stood before a window in her black裙, before her floated a transmission talisman bearing Chen Ji's mark. "Deliberately exposing his identity, drawing out all hidden pieces..." she murmured to herself, a playful smile curving her lips. "Interesting, Chen Ji, what chess game are you setting up?"

And in the distant clouds above, though the Heavenly Eye had retreated into the Void, its gaze never wavered. "Interesting little creature..." that transcendent consciousness echoed through the emptiness. "Host of the Tianji Record, rebel against fate, inheritor of Chen Xuan... how long can you still struggle?" With these words, an invisible thread of karma quietly connected to Chen Ji—the Lethal Edict officially took effect.

Chen Ji stood before the window of the side hall, watching the clouds at the horizon slowly scatter. On his Tianji Record Fragment, a new rune was slowly forming—Master Mo's newly transmitted message: "The storm approaches, the chess game begins. Little one, how will you take your next step?" Chen Ji offered no answer, merely gently stroking the runes on the fragment, murmuring with a smile: "Take one step, see ten ahead. Isn't that what you taught me, Master Mo?"

Autumn winds rose, stirring Chen Ji's robes. The Imperial Capital's bustle echoed distantly, yet beneath this seemingly calm surface, undercurrents surged已成潮. Chen Ling appeared in the Imperial Capital with mysterious allies, the spacetime fissure stirred once more, the Heavenly Eye officially issued the Lethal Edict—three threads converging at this moment, heralding a storm sufficient to overturn the world. And Chen Ji stood precisely at the heart of this tempest, as a waste of a servant disciple, welcoming fate's ultimate trial.
